features.name: Tool contract
features.detail: Defines Lang ('en'|'pt'), Loc (Record<Lang,string>), CategoryId (crypto|encoding|math|lottery|text), the ToolInput union (text/textarea/number/range/select), and the Tool interface: id, category, icon, name, blurb, inputs, run(values,ctx) -> string|Promise<string>, optional visual(values,container,ctx).

features.name: Tool registry
features.file: frontend/src/core/registry.ts :: register / allTools / toolsByCategory / getTool / allCategories
features.detail: In-memory array of tools + a fixed 5-category list. register() de-dupes by id (warns + ignores duplicates). Importing a tool module calls register() as a side effect — self-registration.

features.name: Registration index
features.detail: Single import list that pulls in all 59 tool modules (19 crypto, 13 encoding, 14 math, 2 lottery, 11 text). Imported once by main.ts so every tool self-registers. Adding a tool = one file + one import line here.

features.name: App bootstrap
features.detail: Imports styles, the UI shell, ./tools (self-register) and ./content (educational metadata), loads config.json, then mounts the UI into #app. Config load is awaited (finally) so defaults apply even offline.

features.name: UI shell & router
features.detail: ~600-line vanilla-TS shell: el() DOM helper, hash router (#/tool/:id, #/cat/:id, #/about, #/), header (theme/lang/assistant/about chips), collapsible+pinnable sidebar with search, hero/category/tool views. No UI framework.

features.name: Live tool runner
features.detail: Builds the input form from tool.inputs, recomputes tool.run() on every input event, supports async tools via a runToken guard against out-of-order Promise results, renders errors with a leading warning glyph, and calls tool.visual() when present.

features.name: i18n layer
features.detail: UI strings as Loc {en,pt}; loc(s) returns the active language with EN fallback; t(key) resolves a UI string. Current lang persisted to localStorage ('cm-lang'); default 'en'.

features.name: Theme & favorites
features.detail: theme.ts toggles data-theme (dark/light, CSS variables) persisted as 'cm-theme'. favorites.ts is a localStorage-backed Set ('cm-favs') with isFav/toggleFav/favIds; favourites pin to the sidebar top.

features.name: Runtime config loader
features.detail: Fetches ./config.json (cache:'no-store') at startup and merges over DEFAULTS (assistantMode, cloudEndpoint, lotteryWizUrl, showAllTools). Falls back to defaults if the file is missing/offline — so a published site is reconfigurable without a rebuild.

features.name: Caesar cipher + wheel visual
features.detail: shiftText() does modular alphabet shift; renderWheel() builds an SVG cipher wheel from the current shift. encrypt/decrypt via mode select.

features.name: Vigenere / Beaufort / Affine / Atbash / ROT13 / ROT47
features.detail: Keyword-driven and fixed-rotation substitution ciphers. Vigenere repeats a sanitised key across letter positions; ROT47 spans the 94 printable ASCII chars.

features.name: Bacon / Polybius / A1Z26 / Substitution / Rail Fence / Scytale
features.detail: Encoding-style and transposition ciphers; Polybius and rail fence render grid/zigzag visuals via widgets/visuals.ts.

features.name: XOR / MD5 / SHA
features.detail: xor.ts byte-XORs against a key; md5.ts is a from-scratch MD5; sha.ts calls crypto.subtle.digest for SHA-1/256/384/512 and hex-encodes the buffer.

features.name: Frequency / IoC / Cipher Auto-Solver
features.detail: autosolve.ts computes Index of Coincidence, scores all 26 Caesar shifts by chi-squared against English letter frequencies, applies BINARY/HEX/MORSE/BASE64 format heuristics, and returns the top-3 Caesar candidates.

features.name: Base64 / URL-safe / Base32 / Base58 / ASCII85
features.detail: base64.ts encodes via TextEncoder -> btoa and decodes atob -> TextDecoder, throwing a clear error on invalid input. Others implement their alphabets directly.

features.name: Hex / Binary / Unicode / URL / HTML / NATO / Tap / Morse
features.detail: morse.ts holds a full MAP (letters, digits, punctuation), derives the reverse map, and joins words with ' / '. All bidirectional via a mode select.

features.name: Text transform / analyse / list / generate
features.detail: caseconvert, reverse, count, wordfreq, leet, sortlines, dedupe, findreplace, whitespace, slugify, lorem. slugify.ts uses NFD normalise + \p{M} strip to remove accents before slugging.

features.name: Integer factorization (BigInt)
features.detail: Heavy-tier number theory: mulmod/powmod, Miller-Rabin isPrime over a fixed witness set, Pollard's rho (pollardRho) and recursive factorize(); groups prime factors as p^e. All BigInt.

features.name: Prime / GCD-LCM / Modular Inverse / Base / Roman / Num-to-Words
features.detail: Number-theory and representation tools; numwords.ts spells numbers bilingually using ctx.lang.

features.name: Factorial / Fibonacci / Combinatorics / Quadratic / Stats / Percentage / Temperature
features.detail: Sequences, combinatorics and everyday calculators; BigInt used where values overflow doubles.

features.name: Lottery odds & covering wheel
features.detail: odds.ts uses nCrBig (from util.ts) to compute per-tier 'pick k from n' odds with exact BigInt combination counts; wheel.ts generates a covering play-set. Links out to the QI LotteryWiz app via config.lotteryWizUrl.

features.name: Content store
features.detail: ToolDoc = {explanation, history, trivia (all Loc), source URL, optional link}. A by-id map populated via setDocs(); getDoc(id) feeds the tool view's 'How it works' + 'History & trivia' panels.

features.name: Per-category content
features.detail: Bilingual explanation/history/trivia/source for tools, kept separate from tool logic so content grows without touching tool modules. index.ts imports all five.

features.name: Shared visual builders
features.detail: Reusable HTML/SVG generators: a two-row mapping strip with 'on' highlighting, a 5x5 Polybius grid with row/col headers, and a rail-fence zigzag grid. Consumed by several crypto tools' visual().

features.name: Assistant selector
features.detail: Returns the cloud provider when config.assistantMode === 'cloud', else the local provider. No rebuild needed to switch.

features.name: Local TF-IDF engine
features.detail: Builds a weighted token index over each tool's bilingual name/blurb/category/explanation/history/trivia, with a STOP list (EN+PT), synonym expansion (SYN), accent-normalisation and de-pluralisation. Scores tools with squared-IDF weighting, is context-aware (boosts the tool you're viewing), and returns up to 3 matches above a 40% cutoff.

features.name: Cloud provider
features.detail: POSTs {query,lang,context} to config.cloudEndpoint and expects {text,tools}. Implemented and wired but cloudEndpoint is empty by default, so local mode is what ships. API keys kept server-side, never in config.json.

features.name: Assistant types
features.detail: AssistantProvider / AssistantAnswer / AssistantContext / AssistantToolRef — the shared contract both providers honour so the UI dock is provider-agnostic.

features.name: FastAPI app + QI contract
features.detail: FastAPI 'CypherMiner API' v0.1.0 on port 8502. CORS origins from QI.cors_origins() with a localhost fallback. /health -> {status:ok}, /version -> {project:cypherminer,...}, /info -> registry self-description. Reserved for future heavy/data tools.

features.name: API entry point
features.detail: uvicorn api.main:app on 127.0.0.1:8502, log_level warning. Separate from main.py to avoid the dual-bind conflict (UI is served separately by QI_CypherMinerUI).

features.name: Dual launcher (dev)
features.detail: Dev convenience: starts the API in a daemon thread (uvicorn :8502) and the Gradio placeholder UI on the main thread. UTF-8 reconfigures stdout; logs to data/logs/cypherminer.log.

features.name: Config loader
features.detail: Caches config/cypherminer.json (app name/version, server ports, logging) and loads secrets/cypherminer.env via dotenv if present. get('a.b.c', default) is a dotted-path accessor.

features.name: Gradio placeholder (unused)
features.detail: Legacy QI scaffold; the real UI is the static Vite build on :7842 (QI_CypherMinerUI). Moved to port 7843 so it can never collide with the real UI. Safe to ignore.

features.name: Vite + TS + PWA build
features.detail: Scripts: dev (vite), build (tsc && vite build -> frontend/dist), preview. devDeps: typescript 5.6, vite 6, vite-plugin-pwa 0.21 (offline service worker). No runtime framework dependency.

features.name: QI_CypherMinerUI service
features.detail: Serves frontend/dist on 7842 via 'python -m http.server 7842 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory C:\CypherMiner\frontend\dist'. Logs ui_service.log.

features.name: QI_CypherMinerAPI service
features.detail: NSSM service running run_api.py (port 8502), AppDirectory C:\CypherMiner, auto-start, logs LOGS/api_out.log + api_err.log.

features.name: QI_CypherMinerTunnel (static named)
features.detail: Static named Cloudflare tunnel qi-cypherminer exposing :7842 at https://cypher.quiddityinnovations.com. Legacy quick-tunnel path retained for shipped/customer boxes.

features.name: Smoke tests
features.detail: pytest checks /health, /version, /info and /openapi.json against the running API; every test SKIPS (never fails) if the service is down, so it is CI/offline-safe.
